S-API.description: Server timings over HTTP: hub view, hub conversation, a copy projection, a copy artifact list (generic and scoped)

S-001.description: Stopped hub cold sample 1: T-1, T-2, T-3 with request counts; reopen without refetch

S-002.description: Stopped hub cold sample 2: T-1, T-2, T-3 with request counts; reopen without refetch

S-003.description: Stopped hub cold sample 3: T-1, T-2, T-3 with request counts; reopen without refetch

S-ROWS.description: Every Team row and every member row with statuses and Task summaries (AC-005)

L-001.description: Running large hub: hub row → copy rows and hub click → conversation (AC-003 running, QR-001/QR-002)

L-002.description: New delegation while one copy is open: new row, opened copy keeps its conversation, exactly one projection and one artifact request (AC-007, AC-006)

L-003.description: Composer send to the opened copy of the running hub: shown, delivered, answered and stored (AC-006)

L-004.description: Queued input of a busy copy (sent by a second client) survives a reload and shows when the copy is opened (AC-006, Assumption 2)

L-008.description: Status of a copy woken by a composer send into a held turn: row, header and server agree (REQ-005, REQ-006)

L-009.description: Opening a copy while it works through a burst of turns: loads (or retries on reselect) and ends with its complete conversation (CAND-003 residual)

L-010.description: Opening a copy whose stored conversation is several MB: shown within QR-002 with one projection and one artifact request

L-011.description: A copy whose load fails (network error on its projection) is logged with its identity, stays not loaded, other copies open, reopening loads it (AC-004 alternate)
